dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast horizontal bands visible across the greater and median coverts, characterized by sharp, light-gray edges against a dark-charcoal base.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, linear pale boundaries are clearly visible along the edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low linearity; the pattern of pale-fringed feathers transitions gradually from the crown to the mantle without a distinct boundary line.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive scalloped pattern across all dorsal feather groups created by uniform pale-gray feather margins.
